description: Operation Copy - Copy item to another Exchange mailbox folder
Operation Create - Create item in Exchange mailbox
Operation FolderBind - Access Exchange mailbox folder
Operation HardDelete - Delete Exchange mailbox item permanently from Recoverable Items folder
Operation MessageBind - Access Exchange mailbox item
Operation Move - Move item to another Exchange mailbox folder
Operation MoveToDeletedItems - Move Exchange mailbox item to Deleted Items folder
Operation SendAs - Send message using Send As Exchange mailbox permissions
Operation SendOnBehalf - Send message using Send on Behalf Exchange mailbox permissions
Operation SoftDelete - Delete Exchange mailbox item from Deleted Items folder
Operation Update - Update Exchange mailbox item's properties
Information Event - Mailbox audit policy applied
